title: Private Deployments: RBAC / Audit Logs / KMS Launch — Compliance playbook & release notes runway
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Summary: Coordinate cross-functional launch readiness for Private/VPC/on-prem features: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Audit Logging (structured and retention policies), and KMS integrations (customer-managed keys). This ticket covers product acceptance criteria, release notes and documentation coordination, legal/compliance signoffs, support enablement, and GTM messaging for enterprise customers.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Product teams confirm RBAC, audit log streams, and KMS flows pass acceptance tests on Dedicated and Private deployments. 2) Release notes drafted, reviewed, and staged in the developer docs and support portal. 3) Compliance checklist (SOC2/ISO items that reference logging/KMS) signed off by Security & Legal. 4) Enablement assets (support runbook, troubleshooting playbook, sample Terraform/VPC config, migration checklist) uploaded and reviewed. 5) Customer beta cohort scheduled and first three customers migrated without critical regressions.
updates: 2026-02-22: Kickoff with Eng, Security, Legal, Docs, and Support. Agreed owners for each deliverable; see linked artifact for meeting notes.
2026-02-28: Eng delivered RBAC schema and permissions matrix v1 (ENG-3321). Design reviewing console UI labels for roles — DES-314 assigned to produce screenshots.
2026-03-04: Security requested retention configuration options for audit logs; added to ENG backlog (ENG-3398). Legal requested explicit KMS key handling language for contracts.
2026-03-08: Draft release notes created in docs staging (initial copy + breaking changes section). PM review completed; sending to Docs for style and Security for factual review.
2026-03-12: Support runbook draft received. Customer success identified 4 beta candidates and proposed migration schedule (week of 2026-03-22).
